classification: TASK-035 candidate: the slice178 main build (MTVU, all VU1/VU0 entries AOT) with the GS stream seam. GT4_RENDERER=pcsx2 sends GIF (per path), privileged writes, VSYNC with the field bit and READ_FIFO to a separate GS process over shared memory (docs/GS-STREAM-PROTOCOL.md); no donor Vulkan device is created. GT4_RENDERER unset or donor keeps the donor renderer (headless frames identical to slice157). The pinned GS process is tools/gs_stream_record (no renderer): the window stays black in this mode; it is not for the owner yet.
